purpose: Repair public-page usability failures observed on the eb1b067-aligned client: duplicate hero presentation, oversized Ask answer typography, irrelevant Ask answer display, cropped or blank visual panels, and unusable Reality Navigation geometry.

PUXR-W1.name: Ask PHI OS Presentation Consolidation
outcome: legacy duplicate hero removed from DOM
question and section heading scale bounded
composer and answer vertical rhythm reduced

PUXR-W2.name: Visual Fail-Soft and Full-Asset Rendering
outcome: ILL-010 resolves through verified client visual registry v1.7
supporting figures use contain rather than destructive crop
failed supporting media collapses instead of reserving blank height
copy reflows to readable single-column state when media is unavailable

PUXR-W3.name: Reality Navigation Geometry Repair
outcome: intro copy and boundary card no longer crush each other
loading/empty states stop creating oversized dead space

PUXR-W4.name: Ask PHI OS Question-Relevance Guard
outcome: unrelated upstream answers are suppressed fail-closed
insufficient relevance is explained instead of showing nonsense
no second retrieval or answer authority is created

compatibilityNotes: The predecessor reality-workspace current checker still asserts client-visual-asset-registry-v1.3.json. PUXR intentionally consumes verified v1.7 while preserving the same ILL-010 object key; the historical checker is not rewritten in this batch.
The eb1b067-aligned baseline already contains a stale CKA W5-W17 current-successor fingerprint for assets/js/pages/knowledge-search-b.js. PUXR does not rewrite that historical authority record.
A pre-existing client-visual-consumption-current assertion concerning the Library HERO-002 marker is outside this batch and is not used as PUXR acceptance.
